decision: Measure and retain or reject one exact fixed-M384 target-forward executor specialization.
causal_hypothesis: At exact c32 q_len=12, stock extend attention carries 32 or 64 query rows of live state for only 12 useful rows. An eight-row tile lowers padded work and register pressure enough to beat the extra grid depth.
candidate: Guarded H200 batch-32/M384/max-extend-12 BLOCK_M=8 dispatch with unchanged BLOCK_N=64 and stock fallback.

identities.workload: 32 concurrent exact campaign requests, 358 output tokens, NGRAM depth 12, M384 target verification

quality_gate: Finite numerically equivalent stock/candidate attention outputs through the actual pinned consumer, bitwise deterministic candidate CUDA-graph replay, matching endpoint text/token/finish/usage semantics, exact request identities and token/cache accounting.

slo.retain_rule: Retain any reproducible exact positive component and endpoint effect.
slo.claim_rule: Claim the 20% objective only from the matched endpoint.

execution_order: Claim h200-dflash-adapter-e00vyqp7gxsr34wrtz only after gemma4_h200_dflash_endpoint releases and at least 90 lifecycle minutes remain.
Reconcile and hard-link the exact resident target checkpoint; stage only the immutable packet and pinned runtime image.
Run the stock/candidate exact-consumer CUDA-graph component A/B.
If correct and positive, collect four minimal NCU launches for registers, shared memory, grid waves, HBM, and L2 bytes.
If the measured bound remains material, run one profiler-off matched c32 control/candidate endpoint pair.
Retrieve typed artifacts, account cumulative exposure, and release the unoccupied bench available; use maintenance only for unsafe or uninterpretable retained state.
failure_contract: Preserve invalid launcher/observer/consumer diagnostics and repair only the invalidated operation under the retained claim. Do not replay a complete interpretable component or endpoint sample.
